topics.topic: How import_snapshot passes its single UTC timestamp to the appended AuditRecord
questions: How can import_snapshot make the appended AuditRecord use the single utc_now instant when append_audit accepts no timestamp argument?
Must AuditIntent gain an occurred_at field, or is the AuditRecord timestamp excluded from the requirement to use import_snapshot's single instant?

judgement.why: This asks the same question as P1, and neither the relevant passages nor the change since that judgement altered it.

precedent.topic: How append_audit receives the import_snapshot operation's required audit timestamp without another clock read
quotes: IMPORTED FUNCTION SIGNATURES (these come from the imports above):
def append_audit(repository: AuditRepository, intent: AuditIntent) -> AuditRecord

- AuditIntent fields (exact, no others exist): action: AuditAction, actor_id: UUID | None, actor_kind: ActorKind, entity_id: str | None, entity_kind: AuditEntityKind | None, key_version: int | None, project_id: UUID | None, reason_code: str | None, result: AuditResult
precedent.why: The generated module can supply only an AuditIntent with no occurred_at field to the fixed append_audit signature, so append_audit owns the audit record timestamp and it is excluded from timestamps written by these operations.
